thread:
zoe: Heads-up from enterprise sales: GlobalBank wants one consolidated compliance package for their ISO audit next quarter. Requirements: cross-region log exports (EU->US), BYOK assurance, and an SLA for export turnaround (<= 4 hours). Can we propose an orchestration flow and a minimal MVP?

tom: Quick framing: three moving parts - (1) cross-region data access policy + consent model, (2) BYOK attestation (no unwrap), (3) export SLA and backpressure handling. Need to decide which parts are Dedicated-only vs hosted.

priya: For cross-region: require customer opt-in per export and record consent in the manifest. We should never auto-move customer data across regions without explicit consent. If export crosses regions, encrypt bundle with destination-region ephemeral key and log KMS envelope metadata.

dan: BYOK approach we used in previous threads still stands: provide KMS-signed attestation referencing wrapped-key fingerprint (sha256), plus a per-export HMAC chain over the manifest. No decryption happens. Document that as a limitation for auditors.

legal-bot: Legal note: cross-border exports require the customer's designated privacy officer sign-off and an audit export consent. NDAs still required for auditors. Include consent timestamp and signer email in manifest.

zoe: SLA question: how do we guarantee <=4h? If snapshotting large tenants could take longer. Proposal: tiered SLA: P1 customers (contracted Dedicated) get 4h SLA with pre-warm snapshot capability; non-contracted get best-effort with ETA. We must surface this in the product page.

priya: Implementation sketch for orchestration (pseudo-endpoint):
POST /v2/audit/exports 
body: { tenant_id, window_start, window_end, auditor_info, cross_region: true|false, consent: {signed_by, timestamp} }
Response: { export_id, status: queued, eta_seconds }
(This is just sketch; manifest will include checksums + KMS-sig).

dan: Operational constraints: snapshot job will spawn async workers per shard; ETA depends on active TTL compactions. Recommend pre-warm option where customers can request a scheduled snapshot (e.g., 24h notice) to hit SLA reliably.

tom: Prioritization tradeoffs: supporting cross-region encryption + export orchestration is medium effort but unlocks big enterprise deals. Mark as priority: P0 for sales-qualified accounts, P2 for general availability.

ops-bot: Action items created: 1) product to draft spec + consent UX (assignee: zoe), 2) security to draft BYOK attestation text + manifest schema (assignee: priya), 3) eng to prototype /v2/export orchestration + ETA calc (assignee: dan), 4) legal to finalize consent + NDA flow (assignee: legal-bot).

zoe: Launch criteria (MVP):
- spec approved and signed by legal,
- attestation + manifest schema finalized,
- endpoint implemented with queueing/ETA and single-download signed URL that expires <=1h,
- pre-warm snapshot mode implemented for contracted customers,
- telemetry: export success/fail + signature verification metric,
- docs: auditor checklist + consent UX docs.

priya: Security note: add tamper-evidence requirement. Chain HMAC of files and include KMS-signed manifest.sig. On verification failure auto-revoke export URL and create incident ticket.

dan: I'll run a back-of-envelope for storage impact and snapshot time per 1TB tenant and post numbers in 2 hours. If SLA is required, we should estimate cost uplift and include in pricing addendum.

tom: Decision for roadmap: include orchestration and BYOK attestation in Q3 roadmap as gated feature for Dedicated & Private; cross-region export gated by legal consent automation. Can we add a canary with GlobalBank?

zoe: yes, GlobalBank agreed to be a canary customer pending spec. I'll schedule kickoff with their security lead. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
